commands.review_summary:
Adds subsystem warnings when forward or reverse transcript streaming cannot stat or open a transcript, plus a filesystem-error regression test.

PR surface: Source +8, Tests +8. Total +16 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: invoking either helper with a nonexistent path reaches the changed catch and emits a warning, even though missing transcripts are expected to produce an empty iterator. The submitted terminal proof separately demonstrates the desired EACCES warning path.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A mechanical branch repair can preserve silent ENOENT handling while retaining warnings and focused assertions for genuinely unexpected filesystem failures.

target.title: fix(transcript-stream): log stat/open errors instead of silently returning empty iterator
target.body:
## Summary

`streamSessionTranscriptLines` and `streamSessionTranscriptLinesReverse` used bare `catch { return; }` blocks that silently swallowed all filesystem errors. Replace them with `catch (err) { transcriptLog.warn(...); return; }`.

## What Problem This Solves

In `src/config/sessions/transcript-stream.ts`, both streaming functions catch `fs.promises.stat` / `fs.promises.open` errors and silently return empty iterators. While an empty iterator is the correct contract for missing files, other errors (permission denied, I/O error) should be visible in diagnostics.

## Root Cause

The functions were designed to return an empty iterator when the file cannot be read, but the empty catch blocks discarded all diagnostic information.

## Why This Fix

Same pattern as [#84449](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84449) and [#106385](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106385) — `createSubsystemLogger` + `formatErrorMessage(err)`.

## Evidence

- **Before**: EACCES error silently swallowed → empty iterator, no diagnostic
- **After**: EACCES error logged → `[transcript-stream] Failed to stat transcript /root/nonexistent-transcript.jsonl: EACCES: permission denied`

## Real Behavior Proof

### Before (on main)
```bash
$ node --import tsx proof.mjs
Lines collected: 0
FAIL: No warnings were emitted on stderr!
```

### After (with fix)
```bash
$ node --import tsx proof.mjs
Lines collected: 0
PASS: Warning was emitted on stderr:
  [transcript-stream] Failed to stat transcript /root/...: EACCES: permission denied
```

## Tests and Validation

- `pnpm check` passed
- Added regression test for permission error path
